title: Checks for the use of string literals in exception constructors.
summary: Python includes the raise in the default traceback (and formatters like Rich and IPython do too). Ruff takes this rule from flake8-errmsg and made it stable in v0.0.183.
message_templates: Exception must not use a string literal, assign to variable first
